_doc: Over-the-air settings baked into the build (Docs/OTA.md). cdn_host empty = OTA off: no network, baked content and Resources/Ota/remote_config.default.json only. Host is the DigitalOcean Spaces CDN (ota.brightmoatstudios.com). Path layout is content/[platform]/{contentVersion} and config/{platform}/remote_config.json.
